competitor_gap: Brokers do not disclose underwriter access or benchmark premiums
demand_evidence: The FAA aircraft registry covers a large general-aviation fleet, and AOPA and NBAA both serve owners for whom insurance is a recurring pain point.
unique_data_capture: Anonymized aviation premium benchmarks by make/model, hull value, pilot hours and ratings
commoditization_risk: Low: niche data no AI assistant has
regulatory_notes: Insurance referral compensation limits to unlicensed parties; flat advertising fees only
founder_feasibility: Solo-feasible
mvp_features: Broker profiles with underwriter access; owner matching; premium benchmark submissions; training-discount checklist; type filters
review_notes: With few brokers, subscription revenue is capped; the benchmark report may need to carry the business.
score_justification: L3 LLM matching; E4 MVP in 2-3 wks; A3 steady pilot-forum demand; P3 type clubs and AOPA-adjacent communities; M3 premium benchmarks; W4 owners pay $2k-$20k+/yr premiums (est.)
